Hey there training crew,
Pet comfort, at midday: a short note from our desk

Please keep midday handling calm, orderly, and consistent across all pet movements. The welfare coordinator should confirm comfort cues before any transfer, and the welcome team must brief travelers on carrier placement, ventilation, and the need for quiet handling in the terminal. For the next review cycle, watch for signs of stress, hydrate where permitted, and keep the handoff sequence clear from curb to cabin.

On boarding preparations, apply the same standard to every route and record any exception in the service log. <<FACT F031>> The cabin team should then verify seating, document any special support needs, and maintain a steady check during ascent and descent. <<FACT F053>> If a traveler arrives with a pet that needs extra reassurance, direct the case to the welfare coordinator before boarding continues. <<FACT F048>> These steps help us protect animal welfare and preserve a smooth operation for Aurelia Skyways.

Please reinforce these instructions with every shift handover and remind colleagues that small, calm actions make the largest difference. Maintain professional tone, keep reports precise, and escalate any concern without delay.

Companion Animal Travel Desk,
